thread:
mike: quick repro for a bundler/ESM-CJS edge quirk i ran into — pasting concise steps and a tiny workaround.
mike: env: typescript 5.x, vite 5 / rollup 3, target=es2020, bundling for edge (miniflare/cloudflare).
mike: symptom: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` yields Redwood === undefined only in edge worker runtime; works in node.
mike: minimal repro files: package.json (type: module, exports import->dist/index.mjs default->dist/index.cjs), src/index.ts exports default and named ping, src/app.ts does `import Redwood from 'edge-repro'` and calls ping.
mike: build: rollup -> dist/bundle.mjs. In the bundle the import becomes `const sdk = await import('edge-repro'); console.log(sdk.default)` and default is undefined in edge runtime.

anna: can reproduce on vite+esbuild target=es2020 — node prints default object, worker runtime prints undefined.

kelly: likely cause: dual-published package with exports field; bundler/runtime resolution picks cjs path but treats it as namespace without default interop in the edge loader.

sanjay: workaround: `import * as Redwood from 'edge-repro'` then use `Redwood.default ?? Redwood`. Ugly but works. Alternately remove cjs entry or make exports.import preferred so bundlers pick mjs.

mike: repro commands: clone repo, npm i, npm run build, npx miniflare dist/bundle.mjs --watch — logs show TypeError reading ping of undefined.

kelly: SDK packaging suggestion: ship a tiny ESM-first layout and an explicit re-export wrapper (`export * from './lib'; export { default } from './lib';`) and ensure package.json points module->esm build, main->cjs shim. That reduces ambiguity.

anna: changing tsconfig flags (esModuleInterop / allowSyntheticDefaultImports) didn't affect runtime edge resolution.

sanjay: opened internal issue DEVEX-2345 with steps and bundle snapshot.

ci-bot: pipeline alert: devex/edge-repro build failed — logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/89233

mike: proposed triage: 1) add repro to devex examples, 2) pick packaging policy (ESM-only vs dual) and document guidance, 3) add CI tests exercising edge bundling with vite/rollup/webpack.

kelly: +1, i'll draft an RFC for package layout and include a suggested shim for consumers and bundlers.

mike: ping me if you want the repo branch. :wave:
